evidence.summary: Approved design (status: approved design, 2026-10-10). Decisions: no shared libraries (import map keeps only vue and @lifedashboard/widget-sdk); install unit is dist/<id>-<version>/ from ld-widget build; install by UI upload only; upload-session transport; code (.js .mjs .css .wasm in the root) capped at 10 MB total; assets/ and source/ unlimited; files on disk under userwidgets/, SQLite keeps metadata; v1 replaced by v2 with a migration and .ldwidget.json install removed; ld-widget build copies source/ by default, --no-source turns it off; media by document-relative URL, audio/video imports and media over 100 KB fail the build; workers only from blob: URLs; connect/media/img/font limited to the package, data: and blob:. Out of scope: audio beyond package-local playback, shared libraries, dev mode, zip export, building on the host, publishing the SDK, media quotas, archive distribution and signing. Acceptance criteria 1-8.

Eight tasks: contracts and folder validation; userwidgets storage module; function migrations, migration 6, disk-backed install and sandbox; sandbox serving with Range and CSP; upload sessions and v1 route removal; ld-widget build folder output; UI folder install; examples, README, v1 removal, full verification and browser acceptance. Every step checkbox is unchecked, which records nothing. Task 8 Step 5 (pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, builds) and Step 6 (nine-item Orca browser acceptance) have no recorded results in the plan.

scope.text: Contracts: v2 manifest (format 2), path classes, parseWidgetFolder, PACKAGE_LIMITS and SERVED_TYPES in packages/contracts (commit 72892d9).
Storage helpers for userwidgets/<id>/<version>/, staging and orphan folders in apps/api/src/userwidgets.ts (commit 2996d9a).
Versions on disk: function migrations, migration 6 that moves v1 files to disk, disk-backed install and sandbox (commit 1923cff).
Sandbox serving: assets and code from disk, single Range requests, per-file Content-Type and CSP, document CSP with base href (commit d238150).
Upload sessions in apps/api/src/widget-uploads.ts replace the .ldwidget.json install; v1 install routes removed; session kept alive during a PUT (commits 61291f3 and 86c0142).
ld-widget build emits dist/<id>-<version>/ with assets/ and source/ (--no-source supported) and a path-independent build that rejects symlinks (commits a1e974c and f9800dc).
UI: folder picker and drop, review screen, three-at-a-time upload with progress, cancel and retry, source and asset paths with copy buttons (commits 42fffe7, 3b6fc54 and d575344).
Examples and docs: hello with a background video in assets/, hostile probes, README update; v1 format removed (commit 42039a3).

risks.text: No verification or browser acceptance result is recorded, so the v1 migration, Range and CSP serving, and the upload flow are unverified at 42039a3.
Self-navigation of the frame to an external URL remains the residual risk accepted in v1.
Unlimited media quota lets a package fill the disk; the review screen shows sizes before upload starts.
Migrated v1 versions have no source/. Reinstalling the same version from a v2 build is a CONFLICT because the hash scheme differs.

decisions.text: No shared libraries: each widget bundles its own libraries, and the import map keeps only vue and @lifedashboard/widget-sdk. Reason: each sandbox iframe is a separate JS realm, so a shared copy saves disk only and couples widgets to core library versions.
The install unit is the folder dist/<id>-<version>/ from ld-widget build, so the host runs no build of foreign code. Install is UI upload only, with a review screen and immutable versions.

Upload transport is a session: create with manifest and file list, one streaming PUT per file, then install. No new dependency; large files never sit in memory, and the package is validated before any media is sent.
Code (.js .mjs .css .wasm in the package root) is capped at 10 MB total because WASM is executable code. assets/ and source/ have no size limit, so the user controls disk use.

Files are stored on disk under <dataDir>/userwidgets/<id>/<version>/, and SQLite keeps metadata only. Version hash: sha256 over path and file-hash lines; the same id and version with another hash is a CONFLICT.
v1 packages are replaced by v2 through a migration, and .ldwidget.json install is removed. Reason: one format and one storage path while the project is in early development.
ld-widget build copies the project to source/ by default, and --no-source turns that off. Sources then survive deletion of the development folder, and a forgotten flag does not lose them.
Sources are accessed through absolute paths of source/ and assets/ shown in the packages list with a copy button. Reason: Node has no zip writer, and a download would need a new dependency.

Media is referenced by document-relative URLs assets/...; importing any audio or video file, or another media file over 100 KB, into code fails the build. Reason: Vite library mode inlines imported assets as data: URLs, and media-src does not allow data:.

Workers are allowed only from blob: URLs, because an opaque-origin frame cannot construct a worker from an http URL. connect-src, media-src, img-src and font-src reach only the package, data: and blob:.
